Who are you, really?
Why are you here?
Pressure him to talk.
I… I'm just a messenger.
I was told to wait here. That's all.
Alright! I’ll talk—just don’t hurt me.
He glances at the drain cover and swallows hard.
Show me what you're hiding.
Threaten him with the poison.

对话文本: Fine. I’ll leave—unless you stop me.
You find a damp note tucked inside his coat: a sewer map.
Wait—don’t go! It’s… it’s in the sewers.
His eyes lock on the bottle. He panics and blurts out the truth.
Why are you carrying rat poison?
To clear the infestation. Now talk.
The bottle is empty now—used up.
Head to the sewer entrance.
Ask one more question: what's down there?
Something that hates light… and hates noise.
End the investigation.
Cold air rushes up as you step into the sewer.
Be careful down there. Something lives in the dark.
Move slowly and listen.
Light a torch.
Switch on the flashlight.
对话文本2: A sharp beam cuts through the gloom.

对话文本: You hold your breath. Dripping water becomes a rhythm… then stops.
The torch reveals wet brickwork; shadows crawl along the walls.
The flashlight snaps on; dust spins in the pale beam.
I saw something moving… It wasn’t a rat.
